label: title
js: game.hold(true); game.step(1); JSON.stringify({ touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), scroll: document.getElementById('title').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 })

label: 1P play overlaps
js: (() => { window.overlaps = () => { const r = (el) => el && el.getBoundingClientRect(); const hit = (a, b) => a && b && a.width && b.width && a.left < b.right && b.left < a.right && a.top < b.bottom && b.top < a.bottom; const vis = (e) => e && getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none' && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden' && e.getClientRects().length; const kit = ['kit-help-btn', 'kit-lang-btn', 'kit-sound-btn'].map((id) => document.getElementById(id)).filter(vis); const ctrls = [...document.querySelectorAll('#touch .dk, #touch .tb, .box, .ibtn, .bud')].filter((e) => vis(e) && e.offsetParent); const [x0, y0] = game.toScreen(-10.3, 11.6); const [x1, y1] = game.toScreen(10.3, -0.45); const area = { left: x0, top: y0, right: x1, bottom: y1, width: x1 - x0, height: y1 - y0 }; const bad = []; for (const k of kit) { for (const c of ctrls) if (hit(r(k), r(c))) bad.push(k.id + ' x ' + (c.dataset.a || c.className || c.id)); if (hit(r(k), area)) bad.push(k.id + ' x play area'); } const tcs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#touch .dk, #touch .tb')].filter((c) => c.offsetParent); for (const c of tcs) { if (hit(r(c), area)) bad.push((c.dataset.a + c.dataset.p) + ' x play area'); for (const d of tcs) if (c !== d && hit(r(c), r(d))) bad.push(c.dataset.a + c.dataset.p + ' x ' + d.dataset.a + d.dataset.p); } const boxes = [...document.querySelectorAll('.box, .ibtn, .bud')].filter((e) => vis(e) && e.offsetParent); for (const b of boxes) if (hit(r(b), { left: x0, top: game.toScreen(0, 10.2)[1], right: x1, bottom: y1 })) bad.push((b.id || b.className) + ' x floors'); const small = tcs.map((e) => Math.round(Math.min(r(e).width, r(e).height))); return { touch: document.body.classList.contains('touch'), area: [Math.round(x0), Math.round(y0), Math.round(x1), Math.round(y1)], pxPerM: +game.G.k.toFixed(1), bad, smallestTap: small.length ? Math.min(...small) : null, scroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth + 1 || document.documentElement.scrollHeight > innerHeight + 1 }; }; game.start({ level: 'easy', players: 1, go: true }); game.step(2); return JSON.stringify(overlaps()); })()

label: 2P play overlaps
js: (() => { game.start({ level: 'easy', players: 2, go: true }); game.step(2); return JSON.stringify(overlaps()); })()

label: results
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); w.players.forEach((p) => { p.lives = 1; p.mode = 'bonked'; p.t = 9; }); game.step(3); return JSON.stringify({ screen: game.state().screen, scroll: document.getElementById('results').scrollHeight > innerHeight + 2 }); })()
